_comment: A raise's envelope, one set of cases Java's runner (exec.RaisedErrors), the tab's (engine-client/src/raised.ts) and Python's (legend_lite/_raised.py) each read and agree on: the words each says for 'message' (#104's M2(b), the narrow check's item 7, 2026-11-15; phase D's Phase 2, raises as SITES, 2026-11-16: a raise is a bare token, the kind mark U+001C and LG#<n> (the mark so that a user's fail text is never read as a site: the D part 1 audit's S4), read through the site table its statement declares). A case marked 'refused' names a token the statement does not declare: each reader refuses it by name. A message with no envelope is the database's own failure: kind DATABASE_ERROR, its words the database's verbatim (phase D's Phase 2, item 4).
_aboutSites: the site table of the one statement these cases raise from (PlanJson v56's 'sites' of a statement): each n, its kind, its where, its message (Java's test holds each to error.ErrorKind's sentence and its where, the one source) and, in an edge plan, its upstream words
